table_data.paper_title: Thermal Boundary Conductance: A Materials Science Perspective

columns.Primary Research Focus: Comprehensive review and synthesis of TBC frameworks, measurement methods, and experimental data trends.
columns.Interfacial Bonding Mechanism Investigat: General influence of bonding strength (van der Waals vs. covalent/chemical) on transmission probability ($\alpha$).
columns.Key Measurement Technique(s): Time-Domain Thermoreflectance (TDTR), Frequency-Domain Thermoreflectance (FDTR), 3ω, Cut-bar, Composite Effective Conductivity.
columns.Quantification of Interface Quality: Maximum Transmission Limit (MTL) based on minimum irradiance derivative ($\partial H / \partial T$); average transmission coefficients $\langle \alpha \rangle$.

table_data.paper_title: Ultrafast X-ray Diffraction Mapping of Anisotropic Thermal Transport in GaN Thin Films

columns.Primary Research Focus: Non-contact spatiotemporal mapping of anisotropic thermal transport and defect-induced degradation in buried interfaces.
columns.Interfacial Bonding Mechanism Investigat: Impact of physical defects (wrinkles) and van der Waals bonding integrity on heat dissipation asymmetry.
columns.Key Measurement Technique(s): Ultrafast X-ray Diffraction (UXRD), Finite Difference Heat Conduction Modeling, FDTR (for validation).
columns.Quantification of Interface Quality: Local reduction in cross-plane TBC (25% drop) and in-plane thermal conductivity (4-5 fold decrease) near defects.

table_data.paper_title: Atomic-Scale Control of Interfacial Thermal Conductance via Chemical Bonding Character

columns.Primary Research Focus: Experimental demonstration of direct correlation between atomic-scale chemical bonding character and thermal conductance.
columns.Interfacial Bonding Mechanism Investigat: Transition from weak van der Waals bonds to strong covalent-like bonds via Self-Assembled Monolayers (SAMs).
columns.Key Measurement Technique(s): Time-Domain Thermoreflectance (TDTR), Picosecond Acoustics, Laser-Induced Spallation.
columns.Quantification of Interface Quality: Acoustic reflectance/damping rates (stiffness), adhesion strength (MPa), and absolute G values (MW/m²K).

table_data.paper_title: First-Principles Analysis of Lattice Vibrations and Thermal Conductivity in Monolayer MoS2
Extremely anisotropic van der Waals thermal conductors

columns.Sample Configuration: Polycrystalline r-TMD films with random interlayer rotations; suspended and supported variants
columns.Dominant Phonon Transport Mechanism: Extreme anisotropy: Glass-like 1D transport through-plane vs. phonon-mediated in-plane
columns.Key Structural/Anharmonic Feature: Suppressed transverse acoustic modes and overdamped longitudinal modes due to loss of shear resistance

table_data.paper_title: Thermal Conductivity of Monolayer Molybdenum Disulfide Obtained from Temperature-Dependent Raman Spectroscopy

columns.Sample Configuration: Exfoliated monolayer MoS2 on perforated Si3N4 grids
columns.Dominant Phonon Transport Mechanism: Phonon-mediated transport limited by intrinsic three-phonon anharmonic scattering
columns.Key Structural/Anharmonic Feature: Decoupling of strain effects (E2g) from thermal effects (A1g); small hole size sufficient for low-k material
columns.Measurement/Simulation Methodology: Temperature/laser-power-dependent Raman spectroscopy; First-principles lattice dynamics (Boltzmann transport)

table_data.paper_title: Temperature Dependent Raman Studies and Thermal Conductivity of Few Layer MoS2

columns.Sample Configuration: Vapor-phase deposited few-layer MoS2 (11 layers) suspended on copper grid
columns.Dominant Phonon Transport Mechanism: Radial heat flow from laser spot; dominated by anharmonic decay channels
columns.Key Structural/Anharmonic Feature: Linear red-shift of E2g and A1g modes; substrate support negligible for temperature coefficients
columns.Measurement/Simulation Methodology: Laser-heating Raman spectroscopy on suspended samples; Ridley decay channel fitting

table_data.paper_title: First-Principles Analysis of Lattice Vibrations and Thermal Conductivity in Monolayer MoS2

columns.Sample Configuration: Theoretical model of ideal monolayer MoS2 (no defects/boundaries)
columns.Dominant Phonon Transport Mechanism: Diffusive regime dominated by short mean free paths (~18.1 nm for LA mode)
columns.Key Structural/Anharmonic Feature: Uniformly positive Grüneisen parameters indicating positive thermal expansion; strong acoustic anharmonicity
columns.Measurement/Simulation Methodology: DFPT for phonon properties; NEGF for thermal conductivity calculation

table_data.paper_title: Review on Type-I Clathrate Compounds and Phonon-Glass Electron-Crystal Phenomena

columns.Mechanism of Thermal Conductivity Reduct: Hybridization of guest vibrations with acoustic phonons; Boson peak formation; multi-valley tunneling states
columns.Nature of Dynamic Disorder: Off-center guest displacements in oversized cages creating anharmonic 'wine-bottle' potentials
columns.Electronic Transport Mechanism: Crystalline band transport; carrier-type dependent screening of dipole interactions
columns.Key Theoretical Framework: Interacting Dipole Model for low-temperature specific heat; Unified THz dynamics equations

table_data.paper_title: Lead halide perovskites: Crystal-liquid duality, phonon glass electron crystals, and large polaron formation

columns.Primary Material System: Lead Halide Perovskites (e.g., MAPbBr3, FAPbBr3, CsPbBr3)
columns.Mechanism of Thermal Conductivity Reduct: Diffusive phonon transport due to liquid-like cation dynamics; high polarizability
columns.Nature of Dynamic Disorder: Crystal-liquid duality; rotational dynamics of A+ cations acting as confined liquids/rattlers
columns.Electronic Transport Mechanism: Large polaron formation (sub-picosecond timescale); defect tolerance via dynamic screening
columns.Key Theoretical Framework: Fröhlich/Feynman polaron theories; Modified van Roosbroeck-Shockley theory

table_data.paper_title: On the tuning of electrical and thermal transport in thermoelectrics: an integrated theory–experiment perspective

columns.Primary Material System: Diverse complex systems (Skutterudites, PbTe, Cu2Se, Half-Heuslers)
columns.Mechanism of Thermal Conductivity Reduct: Resonant rattling; part-crystalline/part-liquid sublattices; all-scale nanostructuring
columns.Nature of Dynamic Disorder: Superionic behavior (liquid-like Cu sublattice in Cu2Se); chemical bond hierarchy
columns.Electronic Transport Mechanism: Conductive networks; band convergence; energy filtering/scattering engineering
columns.Key Theoretical Framework: Integrated theory-experiment synergy; Band/Scattering engineering models; Conductive network concept

table_data.paper_title: Coherent Phonon Band Structure Engineering for Sub-Kelvin Thermal Conductance Reduction

columns.Primary Thermal Transport Mechanism: Ballistic coherent phonon transport in suspended 2D membranes
columns.Structural Geometry and Lattice Periodic: Suspended SiN membranes with square arrays of circular holes; Short period (a=970 nm) and Long period (a=2425 nm)
columns.Temperature Regime and Scaling Behavior: Sub-Kelvin (60 mK to ~1 K); Power scaling P ~ T^2.3 to T^5
columns.Key Physical Driver for Conductance Redu: Modified phonon density of states (DOS) and reduced group velocities via band flattening, not solely band gaps
columns.Simulation and Modeling Challenges: Eigensurface sorting algorithms in FEM to ensure continuous group velocity calculation across Brillouin zone intersections

table_data.paper_title: On the tuning of electrical and thermal transport in thermoelectrics: an integrated theory–experiment perspective

columns.Primary Theoretical Framework: Integrated ab initio calculations with macroscopic transport measurements; non-perturbative models for disordered systems
columns.Electronic Transport Strategy: Band convergence, resonant levels, energy filtering, modulation doping, conductive networks
columns.Phononic Transport Strategy: All-scale nanostructuring (point defects to grain boundaries), resonant rattling, part-crystalline part-liquid states
columns.Integration Paradigm: Closed-loop framework linking microscopic band structure/phonon dispersion to macroscopic ZT optimization

columns.Primary Theoretical Framework: Integrated theory-experiment synergy; ab initio band structure and lattice dynamics

columns.Structural Hierarchy & Disorder: Bond-strength hierarchies; large atomic displacement parameters (ADPs); liquid-like sublattices
